name: Onegai @ Countdown
original_name: おねがい@カウントダウン
source:
Late one night, Matsumoto Tetsuya, an average prep school student, picks up a strange card.
He takes it home, ready to call it a night—when something jolts him awake.
Standing before him, tiny and proud, is a self-proclaimed "magical girl" named Saly, who just popped out of the card.
She claims she can grant him three wishes.
Naturally, his first wish is simple: "I want to meet a cute girl!"
But... things don’t go as planned.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080124074148/http://www.yumemiya.net/tsuhan/onekan/onekan_story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
某个深夜，普通的补习学校学生Matsumoto Tetsuya，捡到了一张奇怪的卡片。
他将卡片带回家，正准备睡觉，却突然被什么惊醒。
站在眼前的，是刚从卡片里冒出来、小巧又神气，自称“魔法少女”的莎莉。
她宣称，能够实现他的三个愿望。
理所当然，他的第一个愿望很简单：“我想认识一个可爱的女孩！”
可…事情并没有按计划发展。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080124074148/http://www.yumemiya.net/tsuhan/onekan/onekan_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
